title: Frequently asked questions
description: Answers about using Fun English activities in class, sharing them with students, accounts and privacy.

questions.question: Is Fun English free?
questions.answer: Yes. Every activity is free to play, project and share. A teacher account is optional.

questions.question: Do I need an account?
questions.answer: No. You can play and share any activity without one. An account lets you save **favorites**, organize them in **class lists** and see what you **recently played**.

questions.question: How do I use an activity in class?
questions.answer: Open the activity, choose the options (teams, timer, shuffle) and press **Start**. Press **F** or the fullscreen button to project it. Quiz Boards and Discussion Cards are made for the whole group around one screen.

questions.question: How do my students play on their own devices?
questions.answer: Press **Share** on an activity and send the student link, or show the **QR code** (use *Show fullscreen* to project it). Students don't need an account, and the student link hides everything except the activity.

questions.question: Do you collect data about my students?
questions.answer: No. Student links don't require an account and nothing about the student is saved. See the [Privacy Policy](/privacy).

questions.question: Which levels are the activities for?
questions.answer: Each activity shows its level range, from Beginner to Advanced. Use the level filter on the [Activities](/activities) page to find the right ones for your class.

questions.question: Who makes the activities?
questions.answer: Activities and images are drafted with the help of artificial intelligence and reviewed by a teacher. If you find a mistake, please [tell us](/contact).

questions.question: Can I suggest an activity or report a mistake?
questions.answer: Yes, please do! Use the [contact form](/contact) and tell us the activity name.

questions.question: How do I delete my account?
questions.answer: Email [nfgbrentano@gmail.com](mailto:nfgbrentano@gmail.com) from the address of your account and we'll delete it with all its data.
